name: Large Core Code Benchmark Problem Four (LMFBR)
description: A benchmark problem suite for evaluating neutronics and burnup analysis codes on a large heterogeneous fast reactor configuration.
general_score_metric: relative error on key neutronics outputs (e.g., keff, assembly power distributions)
reputation: A long-standing, domain-specific benchmark used in reactor physics and neutronics communities for verification and validation of neutronics/burnup codes.
notes: Non-ML benchmark that requires specialist simulation codes and domain expertise. Small and highly domain-specific; results depend on physics models and solver implementations rather than standard ML metrics.
